newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove India GDR index down to 78.15.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove India GDR index down to 78.15.

text.p: A weak local market combined with lack of demand softened prices among Indian lobal depositary receipts on Friday.
The Cazenove India GDR index was down 1.09 points or 1.35 percent to 78.15 at 1340 hours.
The Capel index dipped 1.05 points or 1.48 percent to 70.36.
Century Textiles was marked a dollar down at 60.5 while Indian Hotels lost 0.80 cents at 23.325.
The Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index fell 54.91 points or 1.57 percent to 3,439.49 as speculators squared positions.
